builds.title: Orr of the Ford, Galeb Duhr Barbarian 2
builds.difficulty: Tier 1 class-built NPC. CR not assigned.
builds.speed: 15 ft. walking. 30 ft. rolling, or 60 ft. rolling downhill.
traits: Proficiency +2. Strength save +5, Constitution save +4. Wears no armor or shield. Natural AC 14 + 2 is used instead of Unarmored Defense, which would give 10 + 2 + 2.
Outlander grants Athletics, Survival and an additional language. Barbarian grants Intimidation and Perception.

False Appearance requires 1 minute staying still with concentration. Orr then looks like a boulder while stationary. Orr is immune to poison damage and to exhaustion, paralysis, petrification and the poisoned condition.

Rage twice per long rest. Start as a bonus action for up to 1 minute. Gain advantage on Strength checks and saves, +2 damage on Strength-based melee weapon attacks, and resistance to bludgeoning, piercing and slashing. Rage ends on unconsciousness or at the end of a turn unless the barbarian has attacked a hostile creature or taken damage since their last turn. A bonus action can end it early.

Reckless Attack. On the first attack of the turn, Orr can commit to advantage on all Strength-based melee weapon attack rolls that turn. Attack rolls against Orr then have advantage until Orr's next turn.
Danger Sense. Orr has advantage on Dexterity saves against effects Orr can see, provided Orr is neither blinded, deafened nor incapacitated.
actions: Slam. Strength-based melee unarmed strike +5, reach 5 ft. Hit 1d8 + 3 bludgeoning, or 1d8 + 5 while raging.

Rolling Stone. Start or stop with a bonus action. While already rolling, take the Dash action and use a bonus action to slam or shove, then stop. For a shove within 5 ft., make Athletics +5 against the target's Athletics or Acrobatics. On a win, move a Large or smaller creature 5 ft. away or knock it prone.
builds.tactics: Orr stays still at the ford until a trespasser crosses the marked stones. Start rolling to close distance, then Dash and shove on a later turn. Against a nearby hostile, use Rage and slam instead.

builds.title: Rusk Lintel, Gargoyle Fighter 1
builds.difficulty: Tier 1 class-built NPC. CR not assigned.
traits: Proficiency +2. Strength save +3, Constitution save +4. Constitution was chosen for the species increase. Natural AC 14 is 12 + 2 Dexterity.
Soldier grants Athletics and Intimidation. Fighter grants Insight and Perception. Archery adds +2 on ranged weapon attack rolls.
Rusk carries a longbow and quiver of 20 arrows. Rusk uses no armor or shield.
False Appearance requires 1 minute staying still with concentration. Rusk then looks like a statue while stationary. Rusk is immune to poison damage and the poisoned and petrified conditions.
Second Wind. Once per short or long rest, regain 1d10 + 1 hp as a bonus action.
actions: Longbow. Ranged weapon attack +6, range 150/600 ft. Hit 1d8 + 2 piercing. Requires two hands and one arrow per shot.
Claw. Melee unarmed strike +3, reach 5 ft. Hit 1d4 + 1 slashing.
builds.tactics: Rusk watches from an alcove in statue form. If threatened, Rusk flies into clear space to keep distance and fire the longbow. Rusk uses claws if pinned at close range.

builds.title: Hush-of-Five, Gibbering Mouther Barbarian 1
builds.difficulty: Tier 1 class-built NPC. CR not assigned.
builds.languages: Common and Undercommon. Undercommon from Outlander.
traits: Proficiency +2. Strength save +4, Constitution save +5. Unarmored Defense is 10 + 1 Dexterity + 3 Constitution.
Outlander grants Athletics, Survival and an additional language. Barbarian grants Intimidation and Perception.
Limbless body. Hush cannot wear armor, wield weapons or shields, or handle equipment.

Rage twice per long rest. Start as a bonus action for up to 1 minute. Gain advantage on Strength checks and saves, +2 damage on Strength-based melee weapon attacks, and resistance to bludgeoning, piercing and slashing. Rage ends on unconsciousness or at the end of a turn unless the barbarian has attacked a hostile creature or taken damage since their last turn. A bonus action can end it early.
actions: Bite. Strength-based melee unarmed strike +4, reach 5 ft. Hit 1d8 + 2 slashing, or 1d8 + 4 while raging.

Trip. After a bite hits, use a bonus action to try to knock that target prone. Against a Large or smaller creature within reach, contest Athletics +4 against its Athletics or Acrobatics. Hush has advantage when raging.
Blinding Spittle. One visible creature within 15 ft. makes a DC 13 Dexterity save or becomes blinded through the end of Hush's next turn. Once per short or long rest.

Gibber. Every hearing creature within 20 ft. makes a DC 11 Wisdom save, including Hush if able to hear its own gibber. A failure removes reactions until the start of that creature's next turn. On that turn, roll 1d8. On 1–4 do nothing. On 5–6 spend all movement in a random direction with no action or bonus action. On 7–8 make a melee attack against a random reachable creature or do nothing if unable. Once per short or long rest.
builds.tactics: Hush warns intruders to speak one at a time. If cornered, blind the closest hostile and move for the water. Rage and Trip compete for the same bonus action, so on the first turn choose one.

builds.title: Keth Quiet-Beak, Grell Barbarian 1
builds.difficulty: Tier 1 class-built NPC. CR not assigned.
builds.speed: 10 ft. walking and 30 ft. flying with hover.
traits: Proficiency +2. Strength save +5, Constitution save +3. Unarmored Defense is 10 + 2 Dexterity + 1 Constitution.
Outlander grants Athletics, Survival and an additional language. Barbarian grants Nature and Perception.
Blind senses and hover. Keth is immune to blinded and prone. The tentacles cannot hold weapons, shields or hand-dependent gear.

Rage twice per long rest. Start as a bonus action for up to 1 minute. Gain advantage on Strength checks and saves, +2 damage on Strength-based melee weapon attacks, and resistance to bludgeoning, piercing and slashing. Rage ends on unconsciousness or at the end of a turn unless the barbarian has attacked a hostile creature or taken damage since their last turn. A bonus action can end it early.
actions: Beak. Strength-based melee unarmed strike +5, reach 5 ft. Hit 1d8 + 3 slashing, or 1d8 + 5 while raging.
builds.tactics: Keth holds position just under a low ceiling and listens for anyone within blindsight. When forced to fight Keth closes and bites, then retreats through the first narrow bend.

builds.title: Slant, Grick Monk 1
builds.difficulty: Tier 1 class-built NPC. CR not assigned.
traits: Proficiency +2. Strength save +5 and Dexterity save +4. Natural AC 14 is 12 + 2 Dexterity. Monk Unarmored Defense also gives 14 from 10 + 2 Dexterity + 2 Wisdom. Use one formula.
Hermit grants Medicine, Religion and Undercommon. Monk grants Athletics and Stealth.
Stone Camouflage grants advantage on Dexterity (Stealth) checks to hide in rocky terrain. Slant wears no armor and cannot use manufactured weapons, shields or items requiring hands.
Martial Arts. After an unarmed strike as part of the Attack action, Slant can make one bonus-action conventional unarmed strike. Its damage uses the standard monk die.
actions: Beak or tentacles. Melee unarmed strike +5, reach 5 ft. Hit 1d8 + 3 bludgeoning or slashing.
Martial Arts follow-up. After the Attack action above, make a bonus-action body strike +5, reach 5 ft. Hit 1d4 + 3 bludgeoning.
builds.tactics: Slant climbs above the passage, stays still against the rock and talks first. If a hostile presses the issue, strike, follow with the body blow, and climb away on a later turn.

concepts.name: Orr of the Ford
concepts.motive: Keep loaded carts off the shallow stones before the flood.
concepts.hook: Orr needs someone small enough to recover a brass flood marker wedged beneath a stepping stone.

concepts.name: Rusk Lintel
concepts.motive: Recover the order that transferred the old watch post into private hands.
concepts.hook: Rusk has a standing order to guard a closed archway. The person who can revoke it is missing.

concepts.name: Hush-of-Five
concepts.motive: Bring a trapped pipe cleaner back alive.
concepts.hook: Several mouths call out a different name for the same missing worker. The clearest voice can describe a blocked side channel.

concepts.name: Keth Quiet-Beak
concepts.motive: Block traffic through a tunnel occupied by a newly hatched grell.
concepts.hook: Keth will guide travelers through a detour if they can cross the bare stone in silence.

concepts.name: Slant
concepts.motive: Keep a limestone alcove out of a mining claim.
concepts.hook: Slant found survey marks that place a quarry boundary through a burial alcove and wants them brought to its owners.
